incidents.name: Jimbos Protocol rebalance slippage
incidents.notes: JimboController.shift()/reset() rebalanced the protocol-owned Trader Joe liquidity around the current bin with no slippage or price bound, so a flash loan that moved the JIMBO/WETH price before each rebalance let the attacker repeatedly buy back the relocated liquidity below its value.

sources.ref: onchain review: JimboController 0x271944d9D8CA831F7c0dBCb20C4ee482376d6DE7 created 2023-05-25T18:23:43Z by 0x371076d033849c014a3ef37f1a63c44916604cac, not the attack-tx sender 0x102be4bccc2696c35fd5f5bfe54c1dfba416a741; no EIP-1967 events, so the executing code was 2.25 days old. Follow-up transactions 0xfda5464e97043a2d0093cbed6d0a64f6a86049f5e9608c014396a7390188670e, 0x3c6e053faecd331883641c1d23c9d9d37d065e4f9c4086e94a3c34bf8702618a and 0x44a0f5650a038ab522087c02f734b80e6c748afb207995e757ed67ca037a5eda continue the same drain. Loss ~$7.5M as previously recorded.
